agent: UpstreamPr52520b (resumed UpstreamPr52520, which was killed by the provider rate limit with the fix staged but uncommitted)
purpose: Fix vllm-project/vllm#52520: a request the KV cache pool can never hold is admitted, chunk-prefilled to ~99 % of the pool, descheduled, and re-prefilled forever with zero output tokens.

pull_request.title: [Bugfix][Core] Fail requests the KV cache pool can never hold instead of retrying them forever
pull_request.closing_keyword: "Fixes #52520." is the third line of the PR body; GitHub recorded the cross-reference on the issue timeline.

gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.hardware: CPU only, no GPU, no model weights (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""); scheduler driven directly through schedule()/update_from_output()
gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.configuration: hybrid FullAttentionSpec + MambaSpec(mamba_cache_mode=align, num_speculative_blocks=3), block_size=16, max_model_len=1024, max_num_batched_tokens=256, enable_prefix_caching
gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.startup_bound: cdiv(1024,16)=64 attention blocks + (2+3)=5 mamba blocks = 69 blocks; get_kv_cache_configs accepts a 69-block pool
gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.observed_at_69_blocks: prompt=1023 admitted, prefilled to 1008 tokens over 4 steps, self-preempted at the last chunk, then scheduled=0 for every remaining step; VERDICT finished=False computed=0 preemptions=1 status=PREEMPTED
gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.observed_at_70_blocks: same prompt prefills to 1023 and stays RUNNING; one block of headroom is the entire difference
gate_zero_reproduction_before_any_fix.why_1008: (69 - 1 null block - 5 mamba blocks) * 16 = 1008, the sequence length the pool can actually serve

fix.shape: one bound, two call sites, following merged #40946's precedent for SWA/chunked-local
call_sites: runtime: max_servable_num_tokens(vllm_config, kv_cache_groups, num_blocks), new, evaluated against num_blocks - 1 blocks because BlockPool permanently reserves one as the null block
scheduler_changes: Scheduler.max_servable_num_tokens computed once at construction; ERROR log when it is below max_model_len, naming the number the operator needs
Scheduler._is_unservable(request): short-circuits to False whenever the bound covers max_model_len (every correctly-sized deployment), so the hot path is one integer comparison

add_request fails an unservable request instead of queueing it; it is drained in update_from_output as RequestStatus.FINISHED_IGNORED, the same deferred-finish pattern grammar_compile_error_reqs already uses
get_num_unfinished_requests counts unservable_reqs, which sit in no queue, so EngineCore.step is still reached to emit their terminal output
fix.no_behaviour_change_when_pool_is_correct: bound >= max_model_len makes _is_unservable return False on its first comparison; the 70-block reproduction row is byte-for-byte identical before and after
fix.status_choice: FINISHED_IGNORED (maps to finish_reason="length"), which vllm/v1/request.py already documents as the status for prompts longer than the model's length cap. FinishReason.ERROR is documented as a retryable internal error always converted to a 500, which is the wrong contract.

test_evidence.fail_before: on 4d2a68d6 with vllm/ reverted and the test kept: 3 failed, 2 passed in 3.48s. test_max_servable_num_tokens_reserves_the_null_block -> AttributeError: 'Scheduler' object has no attribute 'max_servable_num_tokens'; test_unservable_request_is_failed_not_prefilled_and_retried and test_request_at_the_bound_is_failed_because_it_needs_an_output_slot -> AssertionError: assert not {'0': 256} (main scheduling the first prefill chunk of the request it will discard). The 2 that pass before and after are the over-rejection guards and must never go red.

surrounding_suite.why_they_fail: all four need a GPU-backed engine core; the sandbox is CPU-only

test_evidence.collateral_test_edits: tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py and tests/v1/core/test_async_scheduler.py each gain one line: both build a Scheduler with object.__new__ and set its attributes by hand, so they must set the new unservable_reqs set.

47272.decision: SCOPED AROUND, stated explicitly in the PR body under its own heading
47272.their_row: the capacity side: #47272 subtracts one block from the memory the startup check validates against, so a pool that cannot serve max_model_len is refused at boot. This PR does not touch that code path, and the body says 'Please do not merge this instead of #47272.'
47272.our_row: the request side: make the runtime bound the same function as the startup bound, and give the engine an answer for a request it cannot serve other than retrying it. Needed independently, because the scheduler has no concept of 'never schedulable', only 'not now'. Remains the backstop for _auto_fit_max_model_len, which runs before #47272's reservation.

prior_art_relationship.40946: merged; the design precedent this PR copies (one bound, two call sites) for the same class of defect on SWA/chunked-local attention
prior_art_relationship.35541: closed not-planned/stale; asked for exactly this behaviour ('abort requests that can never fit ... rather than hanging indefinitely')
prior_art_relationship.40384: why the numbers here are stated in blocks and tokens rather than inverted from the 'GPU KV cache size' log line

not_fixed_and_why.preemption_accounting_blind_spot: The issue reports vllm:num_preemptions_total staying at 0.0 across the re-prefills. NOT REPRODUCED on main: the self-preemption path does increment request.num_preemptions and record EngineCoreEventType.PREEMPTED, which IterationStats counts into vllm:num_preemptions_total. So no accounting fix is claimed and none is filed, and the PR body says so. With this PR the point is moot for this defect: nothing is preempted because nothing is admitted.
not_fixed_and_why.http_400: The failure is FINISHED_IGNORED -> finish_reason="length", not a literal 400. Returning a 400 would mean plumbing the pool-derived bound into input_processor._validate_prompt_len alongside max_model_len, a frontend/engine-core change. Offered as a follow-up in the PR body rather than smuggled in.
not_fixed_and_why.startup_refusal: Deliberately left to #47272 (see above); this PR does not change _check_enough_kv_cache_memory or its inputs.
not_fixed_and_why.field_trace_not_replayed: The 261,794-token trace in #52520 came from a downstream fork build on a hybrid Qwen3.5 model. The mechanism is upstream code and the PR demonstrates it on stock main; the fork build itself was not re-run for this PR, and the body states that scope.
